title: Mechanical properties of refractory high-entropy alloys: Experiments and modeling
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting nominal mixtures of the constituent elements (weight percentage purity 99.9%) under a Ti-gettered argon atmosphere. The ingot was remelted at least seven times, flipping the ingot between melts.
